triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: node packages/main/dist/tasks/worktree-authority-smoke.js and node packages/main/dist/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.js both print their respective success lines with zero errors, and both new RED scripts correctly report their target defect is fixed (their own defect-still-present assertion fails).
acceptanceBindings.note: Single acceptance basis covering both bug fixes bundled into this story, matching original_intent_snapshot's acceptanceClaim.

note: Acceptance binding maps the snapshot claim to all 7 checklist items and their verificationIntent refs.
